title: Finite affine refinement of a pro-etale cover
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and assume $S$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $\{W_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering family of the small pro-étale site [sk-def-pe-site], and let $S=\bigcup_{\alpha=1}^t U_\alpha$ be a finite affine open cover [def-pc-scheme]. For each $\alpha$ there exist finitely many indices $i(\alpha,j)$ and affine opens $V_{\alpha j}\subset W_{i(\alpha,j)}\times_S U_\alpha$ whose images cover $U_\alpha$. The finite family $\{V_{\alpha j}\to S\}$ is itself a covering family of $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$: each map is weakly étale [sk-def-pe-morphisms], and the finite affine-refinement condition of [sk-def-pe-site] holds over every affine open of $S$.

source.place: (2) Local models, global bounds: finite affine refinement and verification that the finite family is a pro-etale cover

proof.text: Pull the given pro-etale cover back to each affine U_alpha. Its underlying PreZeroHypercover remains a QuasiCompactCover by the base-change instances in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Cover/QuasiCompact.lean. Apply QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact to the top open of U_alpha, which is compact because U_alpha is affine. Choose these finite refinements for all alpha and convert images of opens into ranges of their inclusions. These are the local covering clauses of [sk-def-pe-site].

For every original covering map W_i → S, WeaklyEtale is given by Scheme.Cover.forgetQc.map_prop, the morphism clause of [sk-def-pe-site]. The projection W_i ×_S U_alpha → W_i is a base change of the open immersion U_alpha → S. Its composite with V_alpha_j → W_i ×_S U_alpha and W_i → S is weakly etale, by the open-immersion and composition instances in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/WeaklyEtale.lean. This uses only the weakly etale notion in [sk-def-pe-morphisms], without the bundled stability theorem.

Write f_p : V_p → S for the selected maps, indexed by p = (alpha,j). Given x in S, choose alpha containing x and then a preimage of x in V_alpha_j from the local covering equality. The pullback identity [def-pc-fibre-product] identifies its image under f_p with x, so the family is jointly surjective. For an affine open W of S, all f_p are quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1), since V_p is affine and S quasi-separated. Their base changes to W remain quasi-compact by clause (3). W → S is quasi-compact by clause (1); hence the composites V_p ×_S W → S are quasi-compact, and their underlying maps are spectral (Scheme.Hom.isSpectralMap).

For x in W, choose y in some V_p mapping to x. Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback gives z in V_p ×_S W over y and x, using [def-pc-fibre-product]. Thus the base-changed family covers W. Apply IsCompactOpenCovered.of_finite_of_isSpectralMap (Mathlib/Topology/Sets/CompactOpenCovered.lean:157) to this finite family and to the compact open W. It takes inverse images of W, which here are whole base changes, and proves exactly the final IsCompactOpenCovered assertion of [sk-def-pe-site]. Together with the affine and weakly etale clauses this proves the unchanged statement.

split_report.summary: Split the finite affine refinement argument into five steps. The given pro-etale covering condition supplies finite affine refinements over each affine U_alpha; weak etale stability gives the maps to S; quasi-separated affine intersections and finite affine covers reduce an arbitrary affine W to finitely many affine pieces; affine fibre products then provide the required finite refinement over W. No new nodes were needed: all non-elementary inputs are existing DAG leaves or the existing weak-etale stability statement.
split_report.blueprint: All five steps realize Step (2) of det-prop-scalar-six-ctf.proof.md: the local finite refinement paragraph and the subsequent verification that the finite family is a pro-etale cover.

lean.statement: theorem finite_affine_proetale_refinement (S : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] (𝒰 : S.Cover Scheme.proetalePrecoverage) (t : ℕ) (U : Fin t → S.Opens) (hU_affine : ∀ α, IsAffineOpen (U α)) (hU_cover : ⋃ α, (U α : Set S) = Set.univ) : ∃ (n : Fin t → ℕ) (i : ∀ α, Fin (n α) → 𝒰.I₀) (V : ∀ α j, (pullback (𝒰.f (i α j)) (U α).ι).Opens), (∀ α j, IsAffineOpen (V α j)) ∧ (∀ α, ⋃ j, Set.range (((V α j).ι ≫ pullback.snd (𝒰.f (i α j)) (U α).ι).base) = (Set.univ : Set (U α).toScheme)) ∧ (∀ α j, WeaklyEtale ((V α j).ι ≫ pullback.fst (𝒰.f (i α j)) (U α).ι ≫ 𝒰.f (i α j))) ∧ (∀ (W : S.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → IsCompactOpenCovered (fun p : Σ α : Fin t, Fin (n α) ↦ (pullback.snd (((V p.1 p.2).ι ≫ pullback.fst (𝒰.f (i p.1 p.2)) (U p.1).ι ≫ 𝒰.f (i p.1 p.2))) W.ι ≫ W.ι).base) (W : Set S))
